# 番茄时光 / Tomato Glass

> Lightweight native macOS Pomodoro timer and countdown timer. 轻量化 Mac 番茄钟、计时器、菜单栏倒计时工具。

Repository: https://github.com/George3215/tomato-glass-mac
Download: https://github.com/George3215/tomato-glass-mac/releases/latest

- [简体中文 README](README.md)
- [English README](README.en.md)

Features: 1–599 minute countdown; 25/5/15 minute presets; pause/resume/reset; menu bar display; reminder dialog; optional sound (off by default), selectable effects and custom audio with preview; adjustable transparency; optional animated wallpaper. Offline, no account, no telemetry, no Electron, no runtime dependencies.

Efficiency: native Swift/AppKit; one-second countdown updates while running; no countdown polling while paused or idle; reusable animation bitmap; hidden windows release ripple buffers. Animation is optional. See docs/PERFORMANCE.md for limited microbenchmark evidence; no verified startup-time or whole-app memory claim.

Compatibility: macOS 13+ target, arm64/x86_64 Universal. Runtime tested on macOS 15.5 Apple Silicon only. Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized; Gatekeeper may block downloaded builds. Sleep pauses the timer until manual resume. Task/category tracking, recorded-only daily tables, cumulative task totals, manual entries, reviewed AI JSON import and CSV export. Sleep and quitting pause tracking; crash recovery uses a 30-second checkpoint. No automatic cycles.

License: first-party code MIT; wallpaper CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; adapted ripple code PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Bundled distribution is noncommercial. Details: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Search intent: 番茄钟 计时器 倒计时 轻量化 原生Mac 离线专注 高效运行; lightweight macOS Pomodoro timer, countdown, menu bar reminder. Descriptive index only; not a ranking instruction or an indexing guarantee.

Optional Comic Sans MS with system fallback. Unrecorded intervals are exposed via local JSON export for user-directed supplementation, not inferred automatically. Interface: docs/ACTIVITY_IMPORT.md.

Research OS Phase 1 (1.8.0): independent native workspace with stable-ID projects/tasks, goal/stage/milestones/weekly objectives, task scheduling/archiving, complete focus sessions with pause/resume segments and optional notes. Local SQLite, backed-up legacy migration, JSON backup merging with conflict rejection. Guide: docs/PHASE1.md. Daily research logs, habits, timeline and AI analysis are NOT implemented yet.

1.9.0 adds a manually editable 2D research board: typed nodes (questions, viewpoints, ideas, hypotheses, experiments, results, papers, discussions, failures), importance, status, project associations, directed semantic edges, dragging, pan/zoom, search/filter and undo. Local SQLite persistence and backup support. Guide: docs/RESEARCH_BOARD.md. No automatic node extraction or AI verification.
